one_line: Crown prince and war leader of the Gajapati dynasty during their mid‑15th century campaigns across coastal Andhra and the eastern Deccan.

appearance.age_look: Late 20s, athletic and broad-shouldered, with the solid build of a seasoned cavalry and elephant commander.
appearance.face: Oval face with a strong jaw, medium-brown coastal complexion, straight prominent nose, sharp dark eyes with thick brows, a faint healed scar across the left eyebrow, and a calm but intense default expression that feels disciplined rather than grim.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair grown to the nape, oiled and combed back into a small low knot at the back of the head; a narrow gold-embroidered cloth band (like a simple turban-strip) wraps around the forehead and ties at the back, leaving the top of the head uncovered.
appearance.costume: Era-accurate mid-15th century eastern Deccan royal-warrior attire: a knee-length, close-fitting quilted cotton coat (zabhon-style) in deep indigo blue with subtle vertical stitching and a front tie, worn over a long-sleeved, light-cream cotton tunic; a broad, brick-red cotton sash wrapped firmly around the waist and knotted on the left side with the ends hanging to mid-thigh; loose but tapered off-white cotton churidar-style trousers gathered at the ankles; sturdy dark-brown leather boots reaching just above the ankle; over the coat, a sleeveless lamellar-style cuirass of overlapping metal plates sewn onto a dark-brown leather backing, leaving the arms mobile; on the forearms, simple steel bracers with minimal etching; around the neck, a modest but dignified gold necklace of small rounded beads, and on the right hand, a single plain gold ring; no exaggerated crowns, just a practical warrior-prince look.
appearance.signature: A long, slightly curved Indo-Persian style talwar with a steel blade, a brass hilt and disc pommel wrapped in dark-brown leather, carried in a dark-brown scabbard with simple brass fittings and always slung from his left hip on a red leather belt so the hilt angles forward.

ref_desc: Hamvira Deva is a late-20s, medium-brown prince with a faint scar over his left eyebrow, thick black hair in a low knot with a gold-embroidered forehead band, wearing an indigo quilted coat under a brown lamellar cuirass, off-white trousers, brick-red waist sash, ankle leather boots, simple gold jewellery, and a brass-hilted talwar in a dark-brown scabbard at his left hip in a palette of indigo, brick red, off-white, dark brown and gold.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of Hamvira Deva, a late-20s eastern Indian prince-general: medium-brown complexion, oval face, strong jaw, sharp dark eyes, faint scar cutting through the left eyebrow, and a calm, disciplined expression; his thick black hair is combed back into a small low knot at the back of his head, with a narrow gold-embroidered cloth band wrapped horizontally around his forehead and tied at the back, leaving the top of his head uncovered. He wears a knee-length, close-fitting quilted cotton coat in deep indigo blue with visible vertical stitching and a front tie, over a light-cream long-sleeved cotton tunic; around his waist is a broad brick-red cotton sash, wrapped tight and knotted on the left with the ends hanging to mid-thigh. Over the coat sits a sleeveless brown lamellar cuirass of overlapping metal plates on leather, protecting his torso but leaving his arms free, with simple steel bracers on his forearms. His trousers are loose off-white cotton, tapering into gathered ankles, and he wears sturdy dark-brown leather boots reaching just above the ankle. Add a modest gold bead necklace and a single plain gold ring on his right hand to show princely status without flamboyance. At his left hip, always include his signature weapon: a slightly curved talwar with a steel blade, brass hilt and disc pommel wrapped in dark-brown leather, sheathed in a dark-brown scabbard with simple brass fittings and hanging from a red-brown leather belt so the hilt angles slightly forward. Use a palette dominated by indigo blue, brick red, off-white, dark brown and gold, and show him from front, side and rear to clearly display his consistent face, hair, armor, garments and sword placement.
